{{Top}}
'''Commissar''' was a rank equivalent to Minister.

==History==
During the [[Pius Dea Era]], the [[Pius Dea]], who ruled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for a millennium as a theocracy, assigned commissars to root out dissidents and other opponents of the ruling regime from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the [[Republic Army]]. By [[11,100 BBY]], the Pius Dea had launched a massive campaign of [[inquisition]]s which led to the mass execution of many disloyal Republic citizens.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

A planet known to have Commissars was [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], having been impressed by the design of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], Grizmallt's Commissars ordered industrial spies and ship designers to reduce [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] lead for new contracts handed out by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="ACCS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] commissars oversaw the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. They had the authority to force prisoners to work at dangerous levels and could strip inmates of their [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]].<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref> During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Tyla Praji]] held the rank of commissar.<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
